item.text: The discrepancy was due to the validator reading only the first member of the concatenated gzip streams produced by `fastp`; the standard `gzip` reader saw all members. I corrected the validator to use multistream gzip support. The full check now confirms 277,113 synchronized pairs, zero filter violations, zero non-prefix/base changes, and raw mate synchronization. I’m doing the final report/configuration and output-scope audit now.
